title: Keep the new Week 10 desk additive until a reviewer chooses integration
option: A: retain isolated `/nfl-b34253a1/` page; B: add a root README/dashboard card; C: consolidate into an existing NFL desk.
decision_basis: Existing root pages and generators have prior owners and CI locks; isolated publication avoids collision.
implementation_status: A implemented only inside the isolated session directory; B/C not implemented.
tradeoffs: A is safest and easiest to roll back, but requires one extra navigation hop. B improves discovery but touches shared README. C risks duplicating or overwriting established work.

title: Make the source timestamp part of every market quote
option: Record operator/book, jurisdiction, UTC capture, market key, line, price, event URL, capture hash and closing quote; otherwise keep quote time blank.
decision_basis: Current public sportsbook pages supplied values but did not expose a persistent UTC capture timestamp in the retrieved page.
implementation_status: Date captured; exact UTC quote time left blank and flagged.
tradeoffs: Improves reproducibility and CLV research; needs lawful access, collection policy and perhaps licensed feeds.

title: Separate injury report, club chart order and confirmed active status
option: Display report status, chart order, final inactive list and actual snap participation as distinct fields.
decision_basis: NFL practice status is not the same as game-day availability; most club charts are labeled unofficial.
implementation_status: Report status and chart order separated; active/snap fields left blank.
tradeoffs: Prevents falsely assuming a backup played; requires final inactives and game-level participation feeds.

title: Do not translate backup string number directly to points
option: Fit position/player-specific replacement coefficients from timestamped participation and game performance with prospective validation; otherwise publish base line and blank adjustment.
decision_basis: Official depth charts supply ordering but do not provide an expected-score penalty for a replacement.
implementation_status: Adjustment schema is explicit; numeric impact remains blank; no adjustment applied.
tradeoffs: Avoids unsupported point moves; calibration needs larger, sourced player-game data and independent validation.

title: Use paired game-level outcomes for same-game and player-prop combinations
option: Register legs, exact prices, settlement definitions, event IDs and paired official game-level player results before estimating joint probability.
decision_basis: Aggregate season leaders alone cannot identify joint event dependence or a fair combo price.
implementation_status: Proposal only; current paired correlations and combo prices are blank.
tradeoffs: Can reveal dependence missed by multiplying marginal probabilities; requires data licensing, exact line history and more samples.

title: Freeze a time-ordered prediction and price ledger
option: Store pre-event features, model/code hash, cutoff time, market quote, final inactive report, result and settlement in an append-only ledger.
decision_basis: The project has no complete timestamped market / wager / settlement record; a retrospective backtest can otherwise use future information.
implementation_status: Not implemented; current walk-forward uses prior-week results only and evaluates margin prediction, not betting return.
tradeoffs: Supports honest walk-forward and CLV; requires operational ownership and retention controls.

title: Keep a fail-closed gate matrix visible beside every strategy
option: Display each gate, evidence, status and missing input; no rank or reward until all gates pass.
decision_basis: Model predictions and descriptive correlations do not establish net skill or expected value.
implementation_status: G0 data reconciliation passes; G1-G10 blocked; leaderboard empty.
tradeoffs: Transparent but conservative; may delay recognition until sufficient prospective evidence exists.

title: Review competition rewards as governance, not a guessed prize pool
option: Before entry opens, choose non-cash recognition or a funded award; publish the amount, source, eligibility, jurisdiction, audit and dispute process.
decision_basis: No reward budget, payment service or contest rules were verified.
implementation_status: No award issued; amount blank and unfunded.
tradeoffs: A real reward can motivate participation but adds budget, compliance, tax and fairness obligations.

title: Show stale-data warnings and the source snapshot time on every category page
option: Add visible as-of badges, source freshness, unverified blanks, source links and dataset download next to each table.
decision_basis: NFL injuries, prices, schedules and depth charts change, and previous repo pages remain frozen at earlier dates.
implementation_status: Current dashboard carries `2026-11-12` snapshot date and per-row source links; it is static.
tradeoffs: Reduces stale-data confusion; live alerting would need an approved refresh service.

title: Treat correlations as descriptive unless the sample and dependence design are pre-specified
option: Publish r, p, 95% CI and n; distinguish team-level ecological metrics from player-level paired-game correlations; use a time-blocked design for qualification.
decision_basis: Current official-data correlations are team-level and one-season walk-forward; player combo correlations lack paired data.
implementation_status: Computed descriptive team-level rows; player/pair rows left blank.
tradeoffs: Less likely to overstate signal; time blocking and prospective replication need more data.

title: Retire or label inherited non-official market and backtest claims before cross-linking them
option: Leave prior owners' files untouched, but make an audit / flagged page distinguish NFL-verified facts from ESPN, PFR, Spreadspoke, Kaggle or nflverse-derived inputs.
decision_basis: The repo is multi-session and existing ownership / CI locks prohibit silently editing prior work.
implementation_status: Audit notes and review flags added in the isolated session; sibling files unchanged.
tradeoffs: Preserves collaborators' work but leaves older pages visible; later owners can decide whether to update or retire them.

title: Add accessibility and responsible-play signposting to strategy pages
option: Use clear non-advice wording, age/jurisdiction reminder, no push betting prompts, keyboard-accessible tables and help links verified for publication jurisdiction.
decision_basis: Research tools must not imply guaranteed outcomes or betting eligibility.
implementation_status: Responsible-use and non-recommendation text included; jurisdiction-specific eligibility remains unresolved.
tradeoffs: Safer communication; local compliance and support links require jurisdiction review.
